# A solution directory outside any go.mod or go.work runs by
# resolving its imports at their latest versions through the ambient
# proxy configuration — here the hermetic fixture serving this
# checkout as v0.1.0 — and with it the clean-completion half of the
# exit contract: a run of finite work exits 0 with no signal
# anywhere, and completion must not read as a wind-down.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

proxy
sdl run
stderr 'running 1 instance\(s\)'
stderr 'ping pong #1'
! stderr 'shutdown'
! stdout .

-- nomod.sdl --
solution nomod

import ff "github.com/modern-engineering/prototype/examples/ff"

deploy ff.Ping as Ping1 {
	params {
		count: 1
		interval: 100ms
		target: "pong"
	}
}
